notes: Performance: MutationObserver now batches DOM mutations into a single animation frame, preventing processing storms on heavy SPAs like Twitter and Gmail
Performance: Visual feedback now uses CSS class toggling instead of inline styles for faster rendering
Fix: Replaced shared stateful regex with a local instance per call, eliminating potential match-skipping bugs
Fix: Popup toggle is now disabled during async initialization to prevent race condition when currentTab/currentHost are not yet set
Fix: Toast and Feedback timers are now properly cancelled on hide/clear, eliminating timer leaks
Fix: Corrected addon ID in updates.json to match manifest.json — automatic update checks were broken in previous versions
Fix: cleanup() now calls normalize() to merge adjacent text nodes left behind after removing bracket wrappers
Fix: stop() now also clears active Toast and Feedback states when the extension is disabled on a site
Fix: Added NOSCRIPT and TEXTAREA to the list of excluded elements during bracket scanning
Compatibility: Lowered minimum Firefox version requirement from 142.0 to 109.0
Fixed issue where disabled sites would re-enable after refresh
Improved domain matching for settings (ignoring 'www' prefix)
Dark mode support for all UI elements
